title: Third Constable's History
full_text:
The Third Constable spoke:

'A prize Arabian mare was stolen from the royal cavalry stables at midnight. The thief had muffled the horse’s hooves with rags and escaped into the desert.

I examined the ground near the gate and discovered a single clear horseshoe print in the damp clay: the left hind shoe was missing its fourth nail, and the iron was notched with three diagonal grooves.

I inspected the five hundred horses in the commercial caravanserais of Cairo until I found a horse with that exact notched horseshoe and the missing nail!

The thief, caught in possession of the royal mare, was arrested, proving that keen observation of minute details unmasks the most elusive criminal.'
moral: Keen attention to small physical details solves the most baffling crimes.
